title: No exception under M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 4 appears in the Department's drug regulations or the Board's regulations, so s. 5 currently has no excepted preparation to apply to
subtopic: Massachusetts regulations searched for exceptions under M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 4
rule_summary: M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 4 allows the commissioner acting jointly with the board of registration in pharmacy to except a compound, mixture or preparation from the application of all or any part of chapter 94C only by regulation pursuant to chapter 30A, only if its three conditions are met, the third being that the compound, mixture or preparation has been similarly excepted under the federal Comprehensive Drug Abuse Prevention and Control Act of 1970 or any amendment thereof, and the regulation shall state the weight of the controlled substance. Under s. 5, controlled substances which are excepted pursuant to s. 4 may be dispensed, or sold at retail, subject to the conditions of that section. As of 2026-09-16, no regulation excepting any compound, mixture or preparation under s. 4 appears in the Massachusetts regulations searched: 105 CMR 700.000, Implementation of M.G.L. c. 94C (the edition published in Mass. Register #1514, 2/2/2024), in which 700.002(A) through (E) establish Schedules I through V as the drugs and other substances listed in 21 CFR 1308.11 through 1308.15 and 700.002(F) establishes Schedule VI as all prescription drugs not included in any other schedule, without stating any exception, and whose regulatory authority cites M.G.L. c. 94C, ss. 2, 6, 24 and 24A but not s. 4; the Department of Public Health's other drug regulations listed in the mass.gov 105 CMR law library, 105 CMR 720.000, 721.000, 722.000, 724.000 and 726.000; and each chapter of the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's regulations listed in the mass.gov 247 CMR law library (247 CMR 2.00, 3.00, 4.00, 6.00, 7.00, 8.00, 9.00, 10.00, 11.00, 13.00, 14.00, 15.00, 16.00, 20.00 and 21.00). On those regulations there is at present no excepted preparation to which s. 5 applies.
exam_relevance: Tests that the route in M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 5 for dispensing or selling an excepted controlled-substance preparation at retail has, on the regulations in force as of September 16, 2026, no excepted preparation to operate on, so a request to buy a controlled-substance preparation without a prescription cannot be met through s. 5.

common_confusions: The conditions and record book in s. 5 describe what applies to a preparation excepted under s. 4; they do not show that any preparation is currently excepted.
A preparation's place in Schedule V, or its federal marketing as a nonprescription drug, is not a regulation under s. 4.
105 CMR 700.002 incorporates the federal lists in 21 CFR 1308.11 through 1308.15 without stating any exception under s. 4.
verification_notes: M.G.L. c. 94C, ss. 4 and 5 read on malegislature.gov on 2026-09-16. On the same date the official mass.gov PDFs of 105 CMR 700.000 (Mass. Register #1514, 2/2/2024; 39 content streams, no decoding failures), 105 CMR 720.000, 721.000, 722.000, 724.000 and 726.000, and 247 CMR 2.00, 3.00, 4.00, 6.00, 7.00, 8.00, 9.00, 10.00, 11.00, 13.00, 14.00, 15.00, 16.00, 20.00 and 21.00 were decoded in full and searched, with and without spacing, for references to M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 4, for the words excepted, ounce, 48 hour, record book, sold at retail and compound, mixture or preparation, and for exempt narcotic or exempt preparation wording; none states an exception under s. 4. 105 CMR 700.002(A)-(F) and the regulatory authority of 105 CMR 700.000 were read in full.
